question: What power to shake the triple world arises from contemplating a smoke-colored form?
premises: A smoke-colored object is to be contemplated always
The triple world is the object affected
The result is the power to shake it
inference: By always contemplating a smoke-colored form, one can shake the triple world.
uncertainties: the exact object of dhūmra-varṇaṃ contemplation is implicit
plain_english: O beloved, by always contemplating a smoke-colored form, one can shake the triple world.
